scope: Read manifest factory, explicit offline provider selection, shared record parser and decoder, source identities/provenance, path policy and focused regression tests. Read AssetSliceStream leaveOpen delta and existing AssetFileStamp/limits helpers. No new native interpretation, live access or independent build/test run.

findings.problem: The initial path policy rejected only raw leading backslashes. Windows accepts //server/share/kh2 and mixed leading slash spellings as fully qualified UNC paths. Path.GetFullPath normalized these before RejectReparsePath, allowing a network filesystem probe despite the explicit local-only contract.
findings.reproduction: Reviewer used only System.IO.Path.IsPathFullyQualified/GetPathRoot/GetFullPath on //server/share/kh2; no filesystem or network operation was performed.
findings.resolution: Reject any two leading path separators before filesystem access, then recheck canonical device and UNC syntax before RejectReparsePath. Seven direct path rejection tests added, covering forward/mixed slash and device forms.

confirmed: Only private factory-created manifests expose known retail/Panacea fingerprints; caller collections are bounded and copied before await, with read-only publication.
Manifest identity includes ordered package providers, decode/transform flags, limits, roots and evidence stamps/hashes; unsupported binaries do not silently become vanilla.

Raw/dev/mod/extract then retail selection follows the declared contract; exact and basename-only lowercase search happens within each package. Existing corrupt/empty/unreadable sources do not fall through.
Record parser uses wide arithmetic and bounded spans; selected HED/header raw lengths must agree; remaster placement is checked without claiming semantic resource safety.
Decoder streams bounded encoded input, separates transform from decode gating, and validates exact decoded size, zlib checksum and supported tail padding.
Read handles and directory handles remain captured until result identity/absence rechecks; leaveOpen slices preserve outer file ownership.
Result is always OfflineManifestBinding. No live loader safety flag, native call or gameplay authorization is introduced.

validation.execution: peer author run; log read independently, no reviewer build

limits: Final absence checks are not an atomic namespace snapshot or runtime loader handoff.
PKG identity/timestamps and selected metadata/content digest do not hash every package byte; cooperative file sharing does not exclude every mapped writer.
The reviewed result is a decoded owned copy. BAR/model/motion/remaster semantic validation and safe native loading remain separate work.
Strict ASCII asset names and local absolute resolved roots are intentional supported-subset restrictions.
